svg.title: What 95% confidence means: 95% bootstrap intervals from 100 samples, 96 of which capture p = 0.30
svg.desc: One hundred horizontal 95% bootstrap intervals, one per random sample of 50 adults, in two panels of 50, against a line at the population proportion 0.30. 96 intervals cross the line and 4 miss it.
svg.text: Proportion with high blood pressure (dashed line: population proportion p = 0.30)
Dot: a sample proportion. Line: its 95% bootstrap interval.
